item.description:
• Musical Intelligence can put cues back in their previous order after a BPM/Camelot reorder
  • BPM detection has fewer undetected tracks
  • Mint no longer fails on some files when Trim is on, and a failed file now says what went wrong
  • Results only show BPM or Key when that detection is switched on
  • Any cue QLab refused during a bulk apply now shows an error instead of a green tick
  • Mono cues routed to an output pair now play 3 dB lower, so they match stereo cues at the same loudness target
  • Renumbering is much faster on big cue lists, and clears old numbers in cue order instead of jumping around
  • Colours, Fade & Stop, Continue Mode and Top & Tail reset now apply in one pass, with far fewer calls to QLab
  • Module runs start faster: cue details load in one go instead of one cue at a time
  • Cancelling a run now marks unfinished cues as Stopped, instead of showing errors for work that was never attempted

• Musical Intelligence reworked: reorder choices come first, and a box the reorder needs greys out instead of ignoring clicks
  • BPM now reports the detected tempo, with a half-time value alongside for fast tracks
  • Every numbering mode shows a progress bar with a running count, instead of just a spinner
  • Cancel greys out while numbering is writing cue numbers
  • Max Outputs now lives in Routing > Multi-Output
  • Warnings and notices no longer shift the page when they appear
  • Disabled controls now say why, right beside them
  • Shorter, clearer notes throughout, with detail moved to hover tips

• Fixed: Mint could put original files at risk: a blank file name suffix in a copy mode, two files with the same name, or an unreadable file could delete or overwrite media - all now blocked with a clear error before processing
  • Fixed: renumbering is now fail-safe: after a failed workspace scan it stops instead of assigning numbers already in use, and a failed renumber restores the original cue numbers instead of leaving them blank
  • Runs now report when a cue number, note or category tag could not be written, and skip group numbering or colouring safely when the selection can't be read, instead of showing success
  • Group sub-numbering uses the selection from the start of the run and avoids collisions on child numbers
  • Renumber, Add Missing and Clear All now cover the whole selection like sub-numbering does - groups and control cues included - so clearing removes every number and renumbering counts from the top
  • Fixed: cancelling or quitting a run, including from Mint, could leave QLab in Edit mode, or flip the mode mid-way through the next run; quitting mid-run now shows a small Finishing up indicator while it tidies up
  • Reordering now warns when it only partially completed instead of claiming nothing changed
  • Fixed: a slow selection fetch could leave the app stuck showing an old selection, and the loaded cue list now refreshes its cue numbers after each run
  • Fixed: Levels could apply a wrong level when measurement was interrupted - now reports an error
  • Large workspaces get more time on Select All, routing, colours and numbering scans, and a report that could not be saved now says so
  • Safer controls during runs (Results Clear, cue filter, module Run buttons), Musical reorder shows its warning in run confirmations, and deleting the active preset switches to Defaults

• Fix updating from 2.2 no longer hides a module that was hidden once in 2.2
  • Fix cancelling a run now returns QLab to Show mode when it started there
  • Fix the cue list no longer sticks on a stale selection after a brief QLab hiccup
  • Fix Mint peak normalise now reports an error when measurement fails instead of silently writing the file unprocessed
  • Fix stopping Mint mid-file no longer leaves a partial output file next to your media
  • Fix closing the Mint window during a preview render no longer plays audio afterwards
  • Fix Top and Tail now reports a missing media file instead of "no silence"
  • Fix the preset edited marker no longer sticks after unticking a clear-notes box
  • Fix cue numbers containing commas no longer confuse renumbering
  • Renumbering and reordering very large selections now get enough time to finish
  • Quitting mid-run now stops background work cleanly

• User presets: save and switch named setups, with a Defaults reset
  • Multi-output routing: send cues to any output, auto-sort by keyword (Music / VOG / FX), up to 64 outputs
  • Mint now processes video too: keep, convert (MP4 / MOV), or extract audio, with trim and fade previews
  • Run All is dramatically faster - around 4x on large shows - from parallel per-cue analysis and batched cue fetching
  • Select All in QLab is now mirrored in Lab Assistant
  • In-app Guide, plus Email Support and Visit Website in the Help menu
  • Musical Intelligence: separate BPM / Key detect toggles and a clearer reorder choice
  • Notes: tidier lines, with optional category and BPM / Key tags
  • Colour-coding for VOG / FX and control cues; group colours now apply reliably
  • Group sub-numbering now takes a prefix and start number, like sequential numbering
  • Stereo-to-mono summing corrected to -6 dB
  • Plus many smaller fixes (routing, Mint, numbering, licensing)

item.title: Version 2.2
item.description:
• Elapsed time added.
  • Lab Assistant now auto switches QLab edit/show mode.
  • Fixes: Colour swatch dragging, Mint processing normaliser now scans post EQ/gain.
